messages:
Sam: Thanks again for joining today’s all‑hands — dropping the recording, slides, and the concrete items we promised to follow up on. Short thread with owners and links below. :sparkles:

Elena: Can you clarify the timing for the Dedicated GA and the minimum commit window for reserved capacity? Some customers asked about quarterly vs annual billing.

Raj: Dedicated GA = target week of 2026-06-15 (tentative). Minimum commit options will be 1mo burstable, 3mo, and 12mo discounted tiers. Official pricing sheet will land in the docs repo by 2026-05-01. For SLAs: aiming for 99.9% for reserved pools, 99.5% for shared hosted tiers initially.

Morgan: Follow-up on rollout tooling — will the console support canary + automatic fallback to cheaper model variants if latency spikes?

Raj: Yes. Console will support canary + policy-based fallback. High-level plan: 1) initial canary UI (Q2), 2) policy DSL for fallback rules + metrics (Q3), 3) automated rollback + traffic shift (Q4). I opened an RFC: https://git.internal/redwood/rfcs/p/684 (short summary in the doc).

Sam: Links: recording -> https://drive.redwood/ah/recording-2026-03-22 ; slides -> https://docs.redwood/slides/ah-2026-q1.pdf ; deck notes + action items -> https://docs.redwood/ah/actions-1799990000 . Also attaching the pricing spreadsheet in the product folder.

deploy-bot: Recording uploaded to drive by sam — file id: drive://file/1a2b3c ; slides PDF uploaded to docs.redwood. :white_check_mark:

Ana: For CS — we need a short FAQ and recommended messaging for customers on Dedicated pricing tiers. Assigning this to @Ana and @Morgan to draft by 2026-04-05. Will circulate to sales.

Morgan: On it. I'll draft the FAQ + 2 email templates for existing customers this week.

Elena: Action on roadmap clarifications — can product confirm whether model pinning for Private deployments is in scope for Q3?

Raj: Model pinning for Private is scoped for Q3 but non-blocking; we’ll ship a v1 that supports pinned model versions via the control plane. Private on-prem full integration might be mid-Q4.

Sam: Action items summary (quick):
1) Raj: Publish Dedicated pricing + SLA doc by 2026-05-01.
2) Morgan + Ana: Draft customer FAQ & email templates by 2026-04-05.
3) Raj + Eng: RFC + ETA for rollout policy DSL (RFC link above), initial canary UI in Q2.
4) Elena: Coordinate comms for product/marketing once pricing doc is live.
5) Courtney: confirm hiring ask in platform team deck (Sam to share headcount slide).

Courtney: I saw the headcount numbers in the slides — can you share the hiring priority list? I need it for the exec review next week.

Sam: Will share the hiring priority list by EOD. Top 4 hires: infra SRE (2), runtime engineer (1), product manager (1).

Raj: One more note — for partner integrations (marketplace) we’ll publish a short partner checklist for compliance and billing by 2026-05-15.

Ana: Noted. I’ll sync with partnerships to ensure the checklist covers SSO/KMS requirements.

Sam: Thanks everyone. If you’re listed as an owner above, please comment on the doc linked here when you start: https://docs.redwood/ah/actions-1799990000 (add updates as you make progress). Closing thread; ping me if anything is missing. :raised_hands:
